# Bundled source skills

These are unmodified copies of the four skills this skill builds on, fetched on 2026-10-29 with
`npx skills use <repo> --skill <name>`. The SKILL files are renamed `SKILL.original.md` so Claude Code does
not load them as separate skills. The adapted, task-specific guidance lives one level up
(`../ui-quality.md`, `../seo-playbook.md`, `../pseo.md`); open these originals only for depth.

| Folder | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `frontend-design/` | https://github.com/anthropics/skills (skill `frontend-design`) | Apache-2.0 (`frontend-design/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `frontend-ui-engineering/` | https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills (skill `frontend-ui-engineering`; the checklist comes from the repo's `references/accessibility-checklist.md`) | MIT (`frontend-ui-engineering/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `programmatic-seo/` | https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills (skill `programmatic-seo`) | MIT (`programmatic-seo/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `seo-audit/` | https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills (skill `seo-audit`) | MIT (`seo-audit/LICENSE.txt`) |

Path notes: `frontend-ui-engineering/SKILL.original.md` links to `../../references/accessibility-checklist.md`;
the file is at `frontend-ui-engineering/references/accessibility-checklist.md` here.
